thread:
Priya N.: new hire following quickstart hit a 403 on first hosted call. they used infra-provisioned workspace (created by our terraform module). error: {"error":"billing_required","message":"workspace billing not active"}

Marco R.: did the terraform attach a billing owner or payment_method resource? sometimes infra creates the workspace but billing is left to human touch.

Priya N.: checked state: workspace exists (ws_tf_122) and shows in Console -> Workspaces, status 'pending_billing'. terraform applied `redwood_workspace.tf` which only sets name and org_id.

Sofia W.: quick checks: (1) CLI cache `~/.redwood/config` can have an old org/workspace that confuses local devs, (2) service tokens created by infra are often scoped to the infra workspace — if that workspace lacks billing you'll see billing_required even if the user is in another workspace.

Priya N.: token came from CI secrets that our infra team generated. how do we inspect token workspace without exposing it?

Marco R.: `curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/whoami -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\"` — it returns json with workspace id (mask it in support threads). or use `redwood tokens inspect <token>` in CLI.

Priya N.: ran whoami, token belonged to ws_tf_122 (the infra workspace) which is unpaid. infra team assumed billing is auto-enabled. oops.

Sofia W.: resolution paths: 1) attach payment method to the infra workspace (Console > Billing) 2) rotate token to be scoped to a paid workspace or a personal sandbox for devs 3) for immediate unblock, create a new personal workspace from Profile -> Create workspace and set REDWOOD_WORKSPACE_ID env var, or use a local mock server.

Priya N.: infra owner added a card and enabled billing. re-ran quickstart and got first successful response:\n```json\n{"id":"r1","status":"ok","output":"hi"}\n```

Priya N.: notes for docs: - terraform-created workspaces may need explicit billing attachment step - token workspace overrides REDWOOD_WORKSPACE_ID/env - add `redwood tokens inspect` snippet and `whoami` curl to quickstart troubleshooting - enhance 403 payload to include a Console -> Billing link and brief next step recommendation

DevEx Bot: Ticket created: DX-4444 "quickstart: infra-provisioned workspace billing checklist + token inspect example" :white_check_mark:

Priya N.: thanks, marking resolved and adding a short paragraph to our onboarding checklist. "
